definitions: The act of canceling something or the state of being canceled.
A mark or stamp on a postage stamp, ticket, or other item indicating that it has been used and is no longer valid.
The act of writing a book, article, or other text.
The state or fact of being the author of a book, article, or other text.
examples: The cancellation on the stamp was clear.
Her authorship of the novel was celebrated.
The committee debated the authorship of the report.
